candidates.excerpt: Up to four cars race at once at the 31st competition, on a track inspired by the Indianapolis Motor Speedway and laid on the smooth concrete floor of the exhibition hall. candidates.title: A 32nd competition proposed for ICRA 2027, with 3D racing
candidates.excerpt: The organizers have proposed the 32nd RoboRacer Autonomous Racing Competition for ICRA 2027. Its new format is 3D racing: a non-planar track with ramps, banks and dips, driven with 3D visual SLAM instead of a 2D lidar.
facts: 'we propose the 32nd RoboRacer Autonomous Racing Competition for ICRA 2027 ... introducing 3D Racing ... non-planar terrain with ramps, banks and dips ... replaces the previous 2D racing which used a 2D lidar, and uses 3D visual slam sensing instead': RoboRacer ICRA 2027 Competition Proposal.docx, intro
Proposed schedule: registration opens Dec 1; video due May 7; setup May 22; competition days May 26-27 (2027): same file, section 3
RoboRacer-Max reference platform (1:10, 'more agile') developed at Penn, released months before the race: same file, section 4

candidates.notes: Proposal only. Nothing in the Drive says ICRA 2027 accepted it; the draft still carries 'IICRA 2027' and 'TODO' placeholders. Do not publish until acceptance is confirmed by Cedric or Rahul.
